data.name: Wilbert
data.gender_notes: Wilbert is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from German Wilibald, composed of wil meaning ‘desire’ and berht meaning ‘bright, famous’; the name Wilbert denotes a resolute warrior. The name Wilbert carries the meaning “Resolute warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Wilbert usually hope their child will grow to embody resolute warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of courage and determination, signifying a strong will and unwavering faith
data.etymology: Wilbert belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Resolute warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Wilbert total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Wilbert, though of German origin, has been adopted widely across different cultures and languages around the world. In various regions, it may be pronounced, spelled, or even translated differently, but its underlying meaning and significance have remained consistently associated with a strong and determined individual.
data.spiritual_significance: Beyond its historical roots and cultural interpretation, the name Wilbert carries profound spiritual significance for those who bear it. It is a reminder of the courage and resilience required in the face of challenges, especially in the spiritual realm. Wilbert symbolizes not only a desire (wil) to live brightly (berht) but also the inner strength and illumination that can guide and inspire others. With faith, Wilbert can be an emblem of spiritual fortitude and a powerful reminder of God's presence and support in our lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Wilbert: Derived from German roots, Wil meaning "will" and berht meaning "bright" or "famous," symbolizing a person with a strong will and brilliant reputation. Spiritually, it represents a beacon of determination and illumination.
